listening.title: Explaining a quotation to a purchasing manager

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Good morning, Mr Tuan. I sent you our formal quotation yesterday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Mr Tuan (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Yes, I received it. Could you walk me through the price breakdown?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Of course. The first line is the software licence for fifty users.

lines.speaker: Mr Tuan (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: And the second line? I am not sure what the setup fee covers.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: It covers installation, data migration and two training sessions for your staff.

lines.speaker: Mr Tuan (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: I see. Is the price tax included, or do we add ten percent later?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: The total at the bottom is tax included, so there is no surprise.

lines.speaker: Mr Tuan (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Good. What happens if we place a bulk order for one hundred users?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Then I can offer a better rate. Let me send a revised cost estimate today.

lines.speaker: Mr Tuan (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Please do. Use the same quote reference so my team can compare easily.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Sure. And I will keep the delivery fee the same for you.

questions.q: What does Mr Tuan ask Hoa to explain?
What does the setup fee cover?
What will Hoa send for an order of one hundred users?
